# Talks at Sunbelt Conference

In June, Ivan and Eleanor are representing the Rep²SI team at the [Sunbelt Conference](https://sunbelt2025.org/) in Paris. Ivan presents preliminary work on "experienced inequality" and subjective social status. Eleanor presents on some related work from the ENDOW project and participates in a round table discussion on Social Networks and Inequality.
